name: Protection From Light both ranks apply their native damage-taken and heal-over-time auras (#3348)
contract: Rank 1 (804065, active, RangeIndex 5 = 40 yd, RecoveryTime/CategoryRecoveryTime 30000 = '30 sec cooldown', DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms = 'for 10 sec', ImplicitTargetA TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY on both effects): effect0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (aura 87 -- the issue's own quoted evidence mislabels this as 'Mod Power Regen', which is actually aura 85; a mislabeling already caught independently by starcaller-constellation-barrier-magic-taken.json), MiscValue 6 = Holy(2)+Fire(4), BasePoints -41+1=-40%. effect1 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL (aura 8), Amplitude 2000 ms = 'every 2 sec'. Both aura types are core generic-engine mechanisms with no CoA script or dummy handler for 804065 anywhere in the source. Rank 2 (704434, passive, family 31): effect0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) with SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, MiscValue 127 = all schools, BasePoints -4+1=-3%, RadiusIndex 12 = 100 yd; effect1 is a self-only (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, MiscValue 2 = Holy only, BasePoints -11+1=-10%. UnitAura::FillTargetMap (SpellAuras.cpp ~2848) gives effect0's target list the caster plus every grouped unit in radius, while effect1 (a plain SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA) resolves only to the caster -- so a raid member picks up effect0 but not effect1, exactly matching the tooltip split between 'party and raid members' and 'your Holy damage taken'. The aura_amount metric reads UnitAura::GetEffect(index)->GetAmount() from the shared base Aura object regardless of which effect mask a given target's own AuraApplication carries, so it cannot by itself prove effect1 is absent from a raid member's application; this scenario therefore proves effect1's exact value only on the caster (where it's real) and proves the raid *scope* of effect0 separately through aura presence/absence (aura metric, which does check per-target application) on a grouped ally versus an ungrouped control character. Both effects are DieSides 1 (no randomised roll), so their amounts are exact and deterministic; the periodic-heal amount on rank 1 (DieSides 2, RealPointsPerLevel 0.25) is not: only its firing is asserted (spell_heal_count/aura_amount effect1 > 0), not an exact number. No CoA script or dummy handler exists for either spell ID anywhere in the source. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively; no code change.
